title: Northgate Memberships Enrollment Terms
content:
## 1. Choice of tier and the entry gate

A membership of Northgate Memberships is opened at the tier the applicant chooses, provided the tier's entry gate is met:

- (a) the primary member must be at least the tier's minimum age of the primary member, in years, on the enrollment date;
- (b) a tier that requires student verification or service verification is opened only with a successful result from the status-verification partner, whose validity date is recorded on the membership as the date through which the verification is valid;
- (c) a tier that requires a business license is opened only in the name of a licensed business.

## 2. Age of the primary member

The primary member must be at least the tier's minimum age, in years, on the enrollment date. The age is read from the date of birth on the customer's record, not from the applicant's statement.

| Date of birth on record against the enrollment date (hypothetical) | Age entry |
|---|---|
| the minimum-age birthday falls on or before the enrollment date | met |
| the minimum-age birthday falls after the enrollment date | not met |

## 3. Business name

A Business or Business Plus membership is opened only for a business name the applicant states exactly as it appears on the business license. The business name is the applicant's statement; it is recorded on the membership exactly as stated.

## 4. First membership year

The first membership year starts on the enrollment date and its expiry date is the day before the same calendar date the tier's length of one membership year later (a start on the 29th-31st that has no counterpart day ends on the last day of the month before).

*Hypothetical illustration:* a membership opened on 15 March 2026 with a 12-month membership year has its first year run from 15 March 2026 to 14 March 2027.

## 5. Fees at sign-up

The tier's annual fee is charged on the enrollment date as a new membership fee. No other fee is due at sign-up, and the free household cards may be added the same day.

## Per-tier reading of the gate

| Tier | Status verification needed to open | Business license needed to open |
|---|---|---|
| Northgate Student Club Membership | student verification | No |
| Northgate Heroes Club Membership | service verification | No |
| Northgate Club Membership | none | No |
| Northgate Business Membership | none | Yes |
| Northgate Club Plus Membership | none | No |
| Northgate Business Plus Membership | none | Yes |

The fee charged at enrollment is, at every tier, that tier's annual fee, and the minimum age applied is that tier's minimum age of the primary member.
